description: This file is a PHPUnit test class for the ZendeskHelpProcessor, which tests various functionalities including URL generation, HTTP client retrieval, and the redirect URL logic within the Help plugin of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: ZendeskHelpProcessorTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the ZendeskHelpProcessor class in the Help plugin, verifying URL formation, HTTP client behavior, and fallback URL logic.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the test case environment, creates an instance of ZendeskHelpProcessor, and loads test fixture data.

methods.name: testGetHelpConfigService
methods.description: Verifies that getHelpConfigService returns an instance of HelpConfigService.

methods.name: testGetHttpClient
methods.description: Checks that getHttpClient returns an instance of GuzzleHttp Client.

methods.name: testGetBaseUrl
methods.description: Ensures getBaseUrl returns the correct Zendesk help center URL.

methods.name: testGetSearchUrl
methods.description: Tests that getSearchUrl constructs the correct API search URL with given label.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl
methods.description: Mocks HTTP response with article data and verifies that getRedirectUrl extracts the correct article URL when the article exists.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl2
methods.description: Mocks an empty result set and checks that the fallback URL is returned when no articles are found.

methods.name: testGetRedirectUrl3
methods.description: Simulates an HTTP request exception and verifies that the fallback URL is returned in case of error.

methods.name: testGetDefaultRedirectUrl
methods.description: Tests that getDefaultRedirectUrl returns the default help center URL.
